svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_def_cov_data_callback Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_def_cov_data_callback:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class containing the default coverage callbacks which respond to the component coverage callbacks, constructs data fields based on what is seen in the callbacks, and then triggers coverage events indicating the data is available to be sampled.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_def_cov_data_callback::lane_transaction_observed_cov
 (  svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor ppi_mon , svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction lane_xact  ) 

Callback issued by the component to allow the testbench to collect functional coverage information from a Lane Transaction that it just received. This is called by the component immediately before placing the Lane Transaction into the output.

ppi_mon - A reference to the component object issuing this callback. User's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the component.

lane_xact - A reference to the svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction descriptor object of interest.
